Q8222.reason: Fever, coryza, and early post-transplant graft dysfunction that mimics rejection fit adenovirus nephritis under heavy induction immunosuppression; BK is usually afebrile and later, and EBV/HSV lack this renal-plus-respiratory picture.

Q8224.reason: Stable blood pressure without urticaria or airway edema leaves bronchospasm as the target, so a β2-agonist bronchodilator is the appropriate drug class; a pure α1 agonist would not relieve wheezing.

Q8227.reason: Acta jure imperii are sovereign or governmental acts done in an official state capacity, unlike commercial acts jure gestionis; not every official act, IO act, or state-corporation act qualifies.
